reason: I'm already on Influish applying to campaigns and waiting, and at my size most local offers are a free meal, not money. I might connect my account since it's free, but I wouldn't pay for another app until it actually gets me a paid collab.
objection: Local cafés pay in food, not money. Another app showing me the same barter offers doesn't change that, and a small beta team in one city might not have many businesses on it yet.
would_change_my_mind: If my first free collab through Mitra turned out to be a real cash payment from a local business, not just food, I'd pay the ₹499.
